description:
You and your friends are invited to Bonk’s private island to play a simple game: the last one still on the island, wins! Play as one of many adorable characters to push your friends to the brink - and past it.

Choose from several different environments and challenges. Be aware that your world may change, tremble or even fall apart as you play! Find fun items and tools to better beat your furry friends, such as branches and acorns. From snowballs to blow darts, blast away!

You can play Bonk! with up to four players in a chaotic, exciting, quick and above all fun game.
name: Bonk!
intro: Action packed, lighthearted, fun. The party game for up to four players.
